_why: What a shared account sees of Shortlist's collections in a library's COLLECTIONS TAB, as opposed to
pms_share_filter_boolean_semantics.json, which measured Home and the library item count.
Measured read-only on 2026-09-13 against a real PMS (1.43.3) with 48 shared accounts, using one
shared account's own server token (plex.tv shared_servers accessToken): GET
/library/sections/{id}/collections for the Movies and TV libraries (plexapi LibrarySection.collections())
and a collection search (LibrarySection.search(libtype='collection')). The owner token listed 186
Shortlist collections, every one with collectionMode 0 ('Hide collection').
1. collectionMode 0 does NOT keep a collection out of the Collections tab or collection search. The
public shared rows (mode 0, excluded by nobody) were listed for the account, 2 of 2.
2. The share-filter label exclude DOES. Every row the account's filter excluded was absent: 0 of 180.
3. So until `label!=shortlist_<slug>` is on an account's filter, that account can see the row's title
and contents in the Collections tab. A person's FIRST row has no exclude anywhere until a merge
writes one, which is why the pipeline merges that person's exclude as soon as their first row is
written, inside the same write lock (`_exclude_first_rows`), instead of at the end-of-run merge.
